quirks.summary: File GETs are session-gated — a cold GET returns an HTML 404, the session alone returns 200.
quirks.workaround: Carry the search session's cookie jar through to every file GET.

quirks.summary: The advanced search offers no 'application received' date filter; use date(applicationValidatedStart/End) instead.
quirks.detail: Posting date(applicationReceivedStart) to an install that does not offer it returns HTTP 500, which reads as a portal fault rather than a bad parameter. Fields present: applicationCommittee, applicationDecision, applicationValidated.
quirks.workaround: Read the date field names off the advanced search form before posting.

source_notes: Clean Idox, standard base path. Non-PDF attachments were JPGs at /files/{hex}/{name}.jpg with NO /pdf/ segment; the stock /pdf/-anchored grep misses them — widen the file grep. File GETs SESSION-GATED (cold -> HTML 404; session-only -> 200). No WAF. _csrf lowercase-UUID. Documents tab advertises a bulk-archive facility (25 docs/archive) — unexercised. PlanIt shortcuts accurate.
